lines.gurmukhi: ਮਿਸਲ ਫਕੀਰਾਂ ਗਾਖੜੀ ਸੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਪੂਰ ਕਰੰਮਿ ॥੧੧੧॥
lines.transliteration: misal phakeeraa(n) gaakhaRee s paaeeai poor kara(n)m ||111||
lines.translation: It is so difficult to be like the fakeers - the Holy Saints; it is only achieved by perfect karma. ||111||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਹਿਲੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਫੁਲੜਾ ਫਲੁ ਭੀ ਪਛਾ ਰਾਤਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: pahilai paharai phulaRaa phal bhee pachhaa raat ||
lines.translation: The first watch of the night brings flowers, and the later watches of the night bring fruit.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜਾਗੰਨੑਿ ਲਹੰਨਿ ਸੇ ਸਾਈ ਕੰਨੋ ਦਾਤਿ ॥੧੧੨॥
lines.transliteration: jo jaaga(n)nhi laha(n)n se saaee ka(n)no daat ||112||
lines.translation: Those who remain awake and aware, receive the gifts from the Lord. ||112||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਾਤੀ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਸੰਦੀਆ ਕਿਆ ਚਲੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: daatee saahib sa(n)deeaa kiaa chalai tis naal ||
lines.translation: The gifts are from our Lord and Master; who can force Him to bestow them?

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਜਾਗੰਦੇ ਨਾ ਲਹਨੑਿ ਇਕਨੑਾ ਸੁਤਿਆ ਦੇਇ ਉਠਾਲਿ ॥੧੧੩॥
lines.transliteration: ik jaaga(n)de naa lahanhi ikanhaa sutiaa dei uthaal ||113||
lines.translation: Some are awake, and do not receive them, while He awakens others from sleep to bless them. ||113||

lines.gurmukhi: ਢੂਢੇਦੀਏ ਸੁਹਾਗ ਕੂ ਤਉ ਤਨਿ ਕਾਈ ਕੋਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhoodhedeee suhaag koo tau tan kaaee kor ||
lines.translation: You search for your Husband Lord; you must have some fault in your body.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੑਾ ਨਾਉ ਸੁਹਾਗਣੀ ਤਿਨੑਾ ਝਾਕ ਨ ਹੋਰ ॥੧੧੪॥
lines.transliteration: jinhaa naau suhaaganee tinhaa jhaak na hor ||114||
lines.translation: Those who are known as happy soul-brides, do not look to others. ||114||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਬਰ ਮੰਝ ਕਮਾਣ ਏ ਸਬਰੁ ਕਾ ਨੀਹਣੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabar ma(n)jh kamaan e sabar kaa neehano ||
lines.translation: Within yourself, make patience the bow, and make patience the bowstring.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਬਰ ਸੰਦਾ ਬਾਣੁ ਖਾਲਕੁ ਖਤਾ ਨ ਕਰੀ ॥੧੧੫॥
lines.transliteration: sabar sa(n)daa baan khaalak khataa na karee ||115||
lines.translation: Make patience the arrow, the Creator will not let you miss the target. ||115||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਬਰ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਾਬਰੀ ਤਨੁ ਏਵੈ ਜਾਲੇਨੑਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabar a(n)dar saabaree tan evai jaalenhi ||
lines.translation: Those who are patient abide in patience; in this way, they burn their bodies.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੋਨਿ ਨਜੀਕਿ ਖੁਦਾਇ ਦੈ ਭੇਤੁ ਨ ਕਿਸੈ ਦੇਨਿ ॥੧੧੬॥
lines.transliteration: hon najeek khudaai dai bhet na kisai den ||116||
lines.translation: They are close to the Lord, but they do not reveal their secret to anyone. ||116||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਬਰੁ ਏਹੁ ਸੁਆਉ ਜੇ ਤੂੰ ਬੰਦਾ ਦਿੜੁ ਕਰਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabar ehu suaau je too(n) ba(n)daa diR karahi ||
lines.translation: Let patience be your purpose in life; implant this within your being.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਧਿ ਥੀਵਹਿ ਦਰੀਆਉ ਟੁਟਿ ਨ ਥੀਵਹਿ ਵਾਹੜਾ ॥੧੧੭॥
lines.transliteration: vadh theevahi dareeaau tut na theevahi vaahaRaa ||117||
lines.translation: In this way, you will grow into a great river; you will not break off into a tiny stream. ||117||

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਦਰਵੇਸੀ ਗਾਖੜੀ ਚੋਪੜੀ ਪਰੀਤਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: phareedaa daravesee gaakhaRee chopaRee pareet ||
lines.translation: Fareed, it is difficult to be a dervish - a Holy Saint; it is easier to love bread when it is buttered.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕਨਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਚਾਲੀਐ ਦਰਵੇਸਾਵੀ ਰੀਤਿ ॥੧੧੮॥
lines.transliteration: ikan kinai chaaleeai daravesaavee reet ||118||
lines.translation: Only a rare few follow the way of the Saints. ||118||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਤਪੈ ਤਨੂਰ ਜਿਉ ਬਾਲਣੁ ਹਡ ਬਲੰਨੑਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: tan tapai tanoor jiu baalan had bala(n)nhi ||
lines.translation: My body is cooking like an oven; my bones are burning like firewood.

lines.transliteration: pairee thakaa(n) sir julaa(n) je moo(n) piree mila(n)nhi ||119||
lines.translation: If my feet become tired, I will walk on my head, if I can meet my Beloved. ||119||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਨ ਤਪਾਇ ਤਨੂਰ ਜਿਉ ਬਾਲਣੁ ਹਡ ਨ ਬਾਲਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: tan na tapaai tanoor jiu baalan had na baal ||
lines.translation: Do not heat up your body like an oven, and do not burn your bones like firewood.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰਿ ਪੈਰੀ ਕਿਆ ਫੇੜਿਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਪਿਰੀ ਨਿਹਾਲਿ ॥੧੨੦॥
lines.transliteration: sir pairee kiaa pheRiaa a(n)dar piree nihaal ||120||
lines.translation: What harm have your feet and head done to you? Behold your Beloved within yourself. ||120||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਢੂਢੇਦੀ ਸਜਣਾ ਸਜਣੁ ਮੈਡੇ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: hau dhoodhedee sajanaa sajan maide naal ||
lines.translation: I search for my Friend, but my Friend is already with me.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਅਲਖੁ ਨ ਲਖੀਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦੇਇ ਦਿਖਾਲਿ ॥੧੨੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak alakh na lakheeai guramukh dei dikhaal ||121||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the Unseen Lord cannot be seen; He is revealed only to the Gurmukh. ||121||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੰਸਾ ਦੇਖਿ ਤਰੰਦਿਆ ਬਗਾ ਆਇਆ ਚਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: ha(n)saa dekh tara(n)diaa bagaa aaiaa chaau ||
lines.translation: Seeing the swans swimming, the cranes became excited.

lines.gurmukhi: ਡੁਬਿ ਮੁਏ ਬਗ ਬਪੁੜੇ ਸਿਰੁ ਤਲਿ ਉਪਰਿ ਪਾਉ ॥੧੨੨॥
lines.transliteration: dub mue bag bapuRe sir tal upar paau ||122||
lines.translation: The poor cranes were drowned to death, with their heads below the water and their feet sticking out above. ||122||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਜਾਣਿਆ ਵਡ ਹੰਸੁ ਹੈ ਤਾਂ ਮੈ ਕੀਤਾ ਸੰਗੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: mai jaaniaa vad ha(n)s hai taa(n) mai keetaa sa(n)g ||
lines.translation: I knew him as a great swan, so I associated with him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਜਾਣਾ ਬਗੁ ਬਪੁੜਾ ਜਨਮਿ ਨ ਭੇੜੀ ਅੰਗੁ ॥੧੨੩॥
lines.transliteration: je jaanaa bag bapuRaa janam na bheRee a(n)g ||123||
lines.translation: If I had known that he was a only wretched crane, I would never in my life have crossed paths with him. ||123||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਹੰਸੁ ਕਿਆ ਬਗੁਲਾ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਧਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kiaa ha(n)s kiaa bagulaa jaa kau nadar dhare ||
lines.translation: Who is a swan, and who is a crane, if God blesses him with His Glance of Grace?

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਕਾਗਹੁ ਹੰਸੁ ਕਰੇ ॥੧੨੪॥
lines.transliteration: je tis bhaavai naanakaa kaagahu ha(n)s kare ||124||
lines.translation: If it pleases Him, O Nanak, He changes a crow into a swan. ||124||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਰਵਰ ਪੰਖੀ ਹੇਕੜੋ ਫਾਹੀਵਾਲ ਪਚਾਸ ॥
lines.transliteration: saravar pa(n)khee hekaRo phaaheevaal pachaas ||
lines.translation: There is only one bird in the lake, but there are fifty trappers.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਲਹਰੀ ਗਡੁ ਥਿਆ ਸਚੇ ਤੇਰੀ ਆਸ ॥੧੨੫॥
lines.transliteration: ihu tan laharee gad thiaa sache teree aas ||125||
lines.translation: This body is caught in the waves of desire. O my True Lord, You are my only hope! ||125||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਵਣੁ ਸੁ ਅਖਰੁ ਕਵਣੁ ਗੁਣੁ ਕਵਣੁ ਸੁ ਮਣੀਆ ਮੰਤੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: kavan s akhar kavan gun kavan s maneeaa ma(n)t ||
lines.translation: What is that word, what is that virtue, and what is that magic mantra?

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਵਣੁ ਸੁ ਵੇਸੋ ਹਉ ਕਰੀ ਜਿਤੁ ਵਸਿ ਆਵੈ ਕੰਤੁ ॥੧੨੬॥
lines.transliteration: kavan s veso hau karee jit vas aavai ka(n)t ||126||
lines.translation: What are those clothes, which I can wear to captivate my Husband Lord? ||126||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਵਣੁ ਸੁ ਅਖਰੁ ਖਵਣੁ ਗੁਣੁ ਜਿਹਬਾ ਮਣੀਆ ਮੰਤੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: nivan s akhar khavan gun jihabaa maneeaa ma(n)t ||
lines.translation: Humility is the word, forgiveness is the virtue, and sweet speech is the magic mantra.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਭੈਣੇ ਵੇਸ ਕਰਿ ਤਾਂ ਵਸਿ ਆਵੀ ਕੰਤੁ ॥੧੨੭॥
lines.transliteration: e trai bhaine ves kar taa(n) vas aavee ka(n)t ||127||
lines.translation: Wear these three robes, O sister, and you will captivate your Husband Lord. ||127||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਤਿ ਹੋਦੀ ਹੋਇ ਇਆਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: mat hodee hoi iaanaa ||
lines.translation: If you are wise, be simple;

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਾਣ ਹੋਦੇ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਤਾਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: taan hode hoi nitaanaa ||
lines.translation: if you are powerful, be weak;

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਣਹੋਦੇ ਆਪੁ ਵੰਡਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: anahode aap va(n)daae ||
lines.translation: and when there is nothing to share, then share with others.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੋ ਐਸਾ ਭਗਤੁ ਸਦਾਏ ॥੧੨੮॥
lines.transliteration: ko aisaa bhagat sadaae ||128||
lines.translation: How rare is one who is known as such a devotee. ||128||

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕੁ ਫਿਕਾ ਨ ਗਾਲਾਇ ਸਭਨਾ ਮੈ ਸਚਾ ਧਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: ik phikaa na gaalaai sabhanaa mai sachaa dhanee ||
lines.translation: Do not utter even a single harsh word; your True Lord and Master abides in all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਿਆਉ ਨ ਕੈਹੀ ਠਾਹਿ ਮਾਣਕ ਸਭ ਅਮੋਲਵੇ ॥੧੨੯॥
lines.transliteration: hiaau na kaihee thaahi maanak sabh amolave ||129||
lines.translation: Do not break anyone's heart; these are all priceless jewels. ||129||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭਨਾ ਮਨ ਮਾਣਿਕ ਠਾਹਣੁ ਮੂਲਿ ਮਚਾਂਗਵਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabhanaa man maanik thaahan mool machaa(n)gavaa ||
lines.translation: The minds of all are like precious jewels; to harm them is not good at all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਤਉ ਪਿਰੀਆ ਦੀ ਸਿਕ ਹਿਆਉ ਨ ਠਾਹੇ ਕਹੀ ਦਾ ॥੧੩੦॥
lines.transliteration: je tau pireeaa dee sik hiaau na thaahe kahee daa ||130||
lines.translation: If you desire your Beloved, then do not break anyone's heart. ||130||
